query: SELECT date_trunc('day',ts) AS source_day,(array_agg(open ORDER BY ts))[1] AS daily_open,max(high) AS daily_high,min(low) AS daily_low,(array_agg(close ORDER BY ts DESC))[1] AS daily_close,count(*) AS source_rows,count(DISTINCT ts) AS distinct_timestamps,min(ts) AS first_ts,max(ts) AS last_ts FROM bars_binance WHERE symbol='BTCUSDT' AND interval='1m' AND ts>=:start AND ts<:end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
